The '''Organa dig site''' was the name of a cave located in [[Kaamos Territory]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Around [[3643 BBY]], a science team of [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] residing in the cave held an old [[House Thul's holocron|holocron]] retrieved by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], with incriminating evidence against [[House of Thul|House Thul]]. As they attempted to crack the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] in order to reveal its secrets, the cave was raided by an Imperial-aligned individual and the Jedi and Organa forces were anihilated and the holocron reclaimed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="'TOR'">{{TORcite|type=general|An Incriminating Holocron|Alderaan}}</ref>
